programme.desc: Today's race starts in Denmark, so Guillaume is inspired to cook their national dish - the stegt flaesk. This grilled pork belly and potato dish is a feast for the eyes and a delicious way to say Bonjour to the Tour.

programme.title: D-day: The Soldiers' Story
programme.sub-title: D-day: The Soldiers' Story Series 1 Episode 1
programme.desc: This is the story of D-Day June 6th, 1944 like it's never been told before. Using the raw, unvarnished accounts of the first young men ashore, presenter Giles Milton reveals an astonishing tale of fear, courage, and heroism. He visits the key D-Day sites along the Normandy coastline including Omaha Beach and Pegasus Bridge.

programme.title: SBS World News
programme.desc: Latest reports and analysis of major national and international news of the day from Australia's only world news service.

programme.title: Next Goal Wins
programme.desc: Based on a true story, this heartfelt, underdog comedy follows the American Samoa soccer team, infamous for their brutal 31-0 FIFA loss in 2001. With the World Cup qualifiers fast approaching, the team hires down-on-his-luck, maverick coach Thomas Rongen (Michael Fassbender), hoping he will turn the world's worst soccer team into winners.

programme.title: Elizabeth Taylor: Rebel Superstar
programme.desc: Over the course of her extraordinary life, Elizabeth redefined what a celebrity could be. She was so much more than an actress. She was a personality. A brand. A survivor. As the series will reveal, she was by no means perfect. But she was real.

programme.title: Princess Anne The Plot To Kidnap A Royal
programme.sub-title: Princess Anne: The Plot To Kidnap A Royal
programme.desc: On 20th March 1974, a terrifying criminal plan, two years in the planning, was enacted: to kidnap Princess Anne. With a planned ransom of 3 million pounds, things didn’t quite go to plan for kidnapper Ian Ball, resulting in an extraordinary Tarantino-esque shootout in central London, in the shadow of Buckingham Palace.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: Milius storms Snowpiercer, holding passengers hostage. Melanie and Ben delay him, but the train reaches Nima's silo. Melanie helps with Gemini research while Audrey escapes to New Eden.

programme.title: Suffragette
programme.desc: The story of the foot soldiers of the early feminist movement - women who were forced underground to pursue a dangerous game of cat and mouse with an increasingly brutal State. Radicalised and turning to violence as the only route to change, they were willing to lose everything in their fight for equality - their jobs, their homes, their children and their lives.

programme.title: Munich
programme.desc: Based on the true story of the Black September terror attack, about the five men chosen to assassinate the ones responsible for that fateful day at the 1972 Munich Olympic Games.

programme.title: Vai
programme.desc: Vai is a feature film made by nine female Pacific filmmakers, filmed in seven different Pacific countries - Fiji, Tonga, Solomon Islands, Kuki Airani (Cook Islands), Samoa, Niue and Aotearoa (New Zealand). It is about the journey of empowerment through culture over the lifetime of one woman, Vai, played by a different Indigenous actress in each of the Pacific countries.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: David Stratton visits the set of Spotswood, interviewing production designer Chris Kennedy, DP Ellery Ryan, and director Mark Joffe.

programme.title: Mr. Holmes
programme.desc: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with early dementia as he tries to remember both his final case and a mysterious woman whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again. Directed by Bill Condon and stars Ian McKellen, Laura Linney and Hiroyuki Sanada.

programme.title: Lucky You
programme.desc: A poker player (Eric Bana) tries balancing a love affair with his aim for a slot in the world championship game.

programme.title: Let Me Go
programme.desc: A neighbour takes care of Claudine's son while she goes to a mountain hotel to meet men passing through. When one of them decides to extend his stay, Claudine finds herself dreaming of another life.

programme.title: Ghoomer
programme.desc: Batting prodigy Anina loses her hand on the eve of her international cricketing debut. A failed cricketer enters her life and with innovative training, she becomes a bowler.

programme.title: Roxane
programme.desc: Raymond, a chicken farmer in Brittany finds himself threatened with bankruptcy when the big supermarkets decide to cut out the local farms from their trade. Inspired by his favourite play, Cyrano de Bergerac, Raymond hatches a plan to save his farm and his business through the art of theatre. Directed by Mélanie Auffret and stars Guillaume de Tonquédec and Léa Drucker.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: An assassin accepts a dangerous mission to kill a political leader in eighth century China.

programme.title: Charro!
programme.desc: Former outlaw Jess Wade wants a fresh start, but his boss Hackett frames him for stealing the Victory Gun. Now branded a thief and hunted by the law, Jess must clear his name and save Rio Seco as Hackett threatens to destroy the town and everyone believes Jess is guilty.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Fourteen-year-old Mattie Ross is determined to avenge her father's blood by capturing Tom Chaney, the man who shot and killed him for two pieces of gold. She enlists the help of Rooster Cogburn, a one-eyed, trigger-happy U.S. Marshall with an affinity for drinking and hardened Texas Ranger LaBoeuf to track down the fleeing Chaney. Directed by Ethan and Joel Coen, and stars Jeff Bridges, Matt Damon and Hailee Steinfeld.

programme.title: Eager Bodies
programme.desc: Twenty-year-old Charlotte is in the midst of a love affair with Paul when she discovers she has lung cancer. They move to Paris together where Charlotte begins an invasive series of treatment. She becomes increasingly depressed while Paul becomes frustrated by his own powerlessness. Then he meets Charlotte's cousin Ninon, and things go awry. Directed by Xavier Giannoli and stars Laura Smet, Nicolas Duchauvelle and Marie Denarnaud.

programme.title: David Rocco's Eating Dirty
programme.desc: On Eating Dirty, David is in Palermo to enjoy a large selection of deep fried delights, gets into some heavy Tuscan traditional fare on the outskirts of Florence.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programme.desc: Justine whips up a delicious bacon and egg open pie, her king fish tartare and Michael Moore drops in to make his Moroccan-spiced pumpkin salad.

programme.title: Instant Italian
programme.desc: Anna shows how to make two of her favorite easy-lift desserts that are perfect for parties. She begins with a simple, refrigerator-friendly cannoli icebox cake.

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Usa
programme.desc: Bill and Paul roll into Jackson, Mississippi, where the soul food culture is famous for making use of every part of the pig. Many favourite local dishes are made from the least expensive parts - including skin, ears, feet, intestines and stomach.

programme.title: Paul Hollywood Eats Mexico
programme.sub-title: Baja California, Milpa Alta, Oaxaca, Yucatan Peninsula
programme.desc: Paul visits Baja California and tastes fresh cactus in Milpa Alta and insects in Oaxaca, then judges a pasty baking competition in a small mining town.

programme.title: Bring A Plate
programme.desc: The guests are thrilled to try Rachel's South Korean dish, Bossam. Not everyone is able to eat the pork but they can all enjoy and learn about kimchi, the hero of all Korean food.

programme.title: Come Dine With Me: The Professionals
programme.desc: Today we're in and around Birmingham, kicking off at Island Lounge, where married chefs Marlon and Dania are showcasing their Caribbean cuisine. It's not long before our hosts realise they’ve got their work cut out trying to impress foodies Mustapha and Jamie, from Jungle Street Kitchen.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Singapore Bitesize
programme.desc: The best bits of Adam Liaw's travels in Singapore, as he explores its vibrant food scene.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: Artisan and hand made farmhouse cheeses have been at the forefront of a growing consumer backlash against innocuous mass produced foods in the United States. Will travels to Northern California to find out more from those responsible for this exciting new movement and after a tour of the Ferry Building farmers market in San Francisco he drives north along the coast calling in on small producers who make great cheese from Cows, Goats and even Ewes milk. Will also catches up with one of the last traditional producers of Monterey Dry Jack, the oldest and most widely known of all Californian cheeses.

programme.title: Destination Flavour Singapore
programme.desc: Adam's in search of Singapore's best vegetable dishes. His journey kicks off with a very Singaporean breakfast at the Singapore Zoo. Here he first meets and greets the resident Orang-utan population, as they share breakfast with a crowd of visiting tourists. He demonstrates how to prepare a Hainanese breakfast favourite - Kaya Toast with Half-Cooked Eggs and Hainanese Coffee.

programme.title: Kitchen Glow Up
programme.desc: Barrie & Morgan are new homeowners & expecting parents. Barrie runs a catering business from home, but with bad storage, a leaky stove hood and no flow.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Great Cookbook Challenge
programme.desc: The cooks create a dish that they will first photograph themselves, followed by working with a professional photographer.

programme.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams

programme.sub-title: Kim Chi, Maple Smoked Bacon & Honey
programme.desc: Derek starts out with a fun way to harvest cabbages, he then helps prepare smoked meats, and helps a beekeeper put a queen bee into a new hive!

programme.desc: Simplicity reigns in the Italian cuisine, and Lidia is a firm believer that simple cooking is better cooking. She makes a cauliflower orecchiette pasta, crespelle, and discusses crepes.

programme.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programme.desc: Creating family dinners overnight for a family of five, with children of different ages, can be quite the task, and God forbid an Italian cook would prepare separate dinners.
